question: In which of the following states was India’s first gender park inaugurated in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first gender park is located in **Kozhikode, Kerala**.
 
• It is an initiative of** the Social Justice Department of the Kerala government **to bring together the state, academia and civil society on a common platform **to address gender issues**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other national parks in Kerala are 

 
 
• Silent Valley National Park, 
 
• Pampadum Shola National Park, 
 
• Mathikettan Shola National Park, 
 
• Anamudi Shola National Park.
